pages.title: Build repeatedly
pages.text: The Auto Constructor uses blueprints in directly adjacent Blueprint Storage. Supply ingredients to the machine itself and collect products from its output slots.$(br2)Connect both flux components and check the redstone mode. It cycles through the library, crafting available recipes when their ingredients and output room are ready.

pages.title: Keep it supplied
pages.text: Allow $(thing)10 of each flux per tick$(), plus $(thing)100 of each per craft$(). The machine has 18 ingredient slots and six output slots.$(br2)Leave room for the entire recipe batch in an output slot. Supply subcomponents yourself: it will not craft missing parts recursively.$(br2)Use an $(l:ariente:automation/first_field)Automation Field$(/l) to deliver ingredients and carry products away.
